specific_waiting.value: 24 months of continuous coverage (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.)

initial_waiting.value: 30 days from first policy commencement date (accidents excluded)

room_rent.value: In-Patient hospitalization covered up to Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule plan

copay.value: Zonal co-payment only if Zone B/C insured takes treatment in higher zone as per Schedule

maternity.value: Covered after 3 years (36 months) waiting period up to limits specified in benefit B21

ayush.value: In-Patient or Day Care AYUSH treatment covered in an AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day Care Centre

daycare.value: Day Care Treatment covered up to Sum Insured

pre_post.value: 60 days pre-hospitalisation; 90 days post-hospitalisation (up to ₹50L SI) or 200 days (₹75L–₹3Cr SI)

ncb.value: Cumulative Bonus 50% of Basic Sum Insured per claim-free year up to 100% (or Renewal Premium Discount option)

sublimits.value: Hearing Aid 50% or ₹10,000; Maternity per benefit table; Robotic surgeries covered under Modern Treatments
